Base running workshops

Base Running Science™ delivers focused workshops for coaches, performance staff, teams and academies. Choose a one-hour introduction or a two-hour applied workshop, tailored to your audience and one agreed base running topic.

One-hour workshop — Understand the task

A focused session to connect the science of base running with practical testing and training decisions.

  • 10 minutes: Your context, objectives and the demands of running between bases.
  • 30 minutes: One agreed topic, supported by research and practical examples.
  • 20 minutes: Guided discussion, questions and takeaways for your setting.

Included: A short preparation questionnaire, one live 60-minute session and a concise takeaway handout. Best suited to introducing a topic or helping staff develop a shared understanding.

Request a quote for the one-hour workshop

Two-hour workshop — Apply the task

An interactive session with more time to interpret examples and connect findings to training practice.

  • 15 minutes: Your context, objectives and key base running demands.
  • 35 minutes: Evidence and practical principles for one agreed topic.
  • 40 minutes: A guided case exercise, video discussion or agreed onsite demonstration.
  • 20 minutes: Translate the example into testing or training priorities.
  • 10 minutes: Questions and next steps.

Included: A short preparation questionnaire, one live 120-minute session, a takeaway handout and an applied exercise worksheet. Best suited to staff who want to work through an example and discuss how to apply it in their setting.

Request a quote for the two-hour workshop

Choose a focus

  • Linear and curvilinear running demands in baseball.
  • Testing beyond total sprint time: what measurements can and cannot tell us.
  • Connecting assessment findings to physical preparation and on-field training.
  • Using reassessment to review progress and adjust development priorities.

We agree the focus and audience in advance so the session fits the available time. Examples distinguish baseball-specific findings from principles drawn from other sports.

Format and booking

Both packages are available remotely or onsite by arrangement. Your quote confirms participant numbers, topic, session format, preparation, materials, dates and fees. Onsite demonstrations depend on appropriate facilities and an agreed activity plan. Travel, accommodation, field hire and additional technology are separately quoted where needed.

Workshops use agreed teaching examples. Individual athlete testing, bespoke data analysis and ongoing coaching are separate services. These are standalone workshops; accredited continuing-education credits and qualifications are not offered.

Tell us your preferred duration, audience, participant numbers, topic, location and dates.
